name: Bollinger %B(21,2) extreme mean reversion (-0.2 / 1.2)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Intended for short holding (few candles) on higher timeframes.
entry_long: Go long when %B < -0.2 (close below lower band by 20% of band width) and flat.
exit: Close long when %B >= 0.2; close short when %B <= 1.0.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Exit thresholds ob_close=1.0 / os_close=0.2 are inputs; short close condition inferred from symmetrical inputs (script closes with the same close_all block).
